title: Do you need protein within 30 minutes? ⏱️🥤
caption:
A meta-analysis found that when daily protein was equal, timing barely mattered. Your muscles stay ready to build for a day or more. Hit about 1.6 g per kg a day over 3-4 meals. Shaker in the locker room or no? 👇

Gym Myths Busted #5
first_comment: Who has sprinted to the locker room to drink their shake in time? 🏃‍♂️🥤
sources: Schoenfeld BJ, Aragon AA, Krieger JW. The effect of protein timing on muscle strength and hypertrophy: a meta-analysis. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2013;10:53
Aragon AA, Schoenfeld BJ. Nutrient timing revisited: is there a post-exercise anabolic window? J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2013;10:5
